messages:
marta: Quick ask: can someone run a microburst + prefix-cache regression for auriga-6b (quant-v2) on the canary pool? Seeing occasional p99 spikes in staging.
ryan: Got it. what's the exact config? batch policy, seq len samples?
marta: Seq dist: 96/512/1024; burst: 200 concurrent short requests (avg 30 tokens). Use adaptive batching enabled, kv_cache on. Tag run with `auriga-microburst-0326`.
ops-bot: Scheduling bench job auriga-microburst-0326 on canary-gpu-pool. ETA 8m.
divya: Also include tiling=on and disable mem-compaction for one run — want to compare.
ash: I'll grab a heap/profile and run perf counters. Send me the job id when scheduled.
ops-bot: Job 54213 started on node canary-gpu-7. Logs: https://ci.redwood/54213/stream
ryan: Preliminary numbers: p50=18ms, p95=75ms, p99=420ms. CPU steal looks low. KV hits ~24%.
marta: 420ms p99 still high. Any correlations with eviction or GC?
ash: Heap snapshot shows KV cache churn spikes aligned with p99. Attaching flame snippet: ```kv_cache::evict (30%) -> serialize (10ms) -> grpc-send```
divya: When we toggled tiling off in run 2, p99 dropped to 210ms but throughput fell 8%.
ryan: Action items: 1) increase KV cache size by 20% on canary nodes; 2) try compaction on/off sweep; 3) run a longer 30m soak with mixed seq len.
marta: :thumbsup: I'll file the rollout hold for auriga-6b -- hold until soak passes. Created issue https://tracker/INF-987
ops-bot: Noted: rollout hold applied to auriga-6b 1.0.2 in canary.
ash: I'll follow up with perf counters and a metric dashboard for next 30m run.
divya: If soak passes we'll test quant-v1 vs quant-v2 in controlled A/B.
ryan: If anyone needs the raw traces: https://s3.redwood/auriga/54213/traces.tar.gz
marta: Thanks all — please ping here when soak completes. /cc @emily @kai
